dict.string: StillHere uses the camera only for video calls you start or answer with your Safety Circle.
StillHere uses the microphone only for voice and video calls you start or answer with your Safety Circle.
StillHere uses your location only when you choose to share it or when you start a safety feature like a check-in, Safe Walk, Safety Timer, Drive Safety, or SOS. Location sharing is off by default.

StillHere uses background location only when you turn on a feature that needs it, such as Safe Walk, Safety Timer, Drive Safety, active sharing with your Safety Circle, or an SOS in progress. If a check-in is missed or you trigger help, we will attempt to share your location with the contacts you chose so they can reach you. StillHere is not a continuous tracking app and does not collect location during calm time when you are in Presence mode or have sharing paused.
StillHere uses motion sensors to look for possible fall or vehicle-crash signals during Drive Safety and Safe Walk. These are best-effort sensor signals, not medical-grade detection.
